# CLAUDE.md（openvela 工作区）—— PhyWear 项目

**本工作区是 PhyWear 的开发工作区，项目唯一权威记忆在参赛仓：**
`~/work/contest2026_427_xinpingqihe/CLAUDE.md` —— **开工前先读它**（角色分工 / 当前状态 / 铁律 / 收尾日志）。

## 在这里工作必须记住的 5 条
1. 这里（`~/openvela`）的改动要**回写**到参赛仓快照：
   `cd ~/work/contest2026_427_xinpingqihe && python3 .claude/skills/phywear-reproduce/sync_back.py`（先演练，`--execute` 落盘）
2. 提交只能走 `bash .claude/skills/phywear-submit/submit_427.sh`（在参赛仓里跑，默认演练）。
3. 串口铁律：`pyserial` 开串口后立刻 `dtr=False; rts=False`；`picocom` 必须 `--noreset --lower-rts --lower-dtr`；
   `/dev/ttyUSB0` 独占；**禁止 `erase_flash`**；**一个 boot 只跑一个 `phywear` GUI**。
4. 构建真机固件：`cmake --build cmake_out/sf32lb52_lchspi_ulp_nsh_ai -j16`
   （PATH 需含 `prebuilts/tools/linux/x86_64`、`prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/aarch64-none-elf/bin`、`vendor/artinchip/tools/scripts`）
5. 会话结束务必：`bash ~/work/contest2026_427_xinpingqihe/.claude/skills/phywear-migrate/finish_session.sh`
   （把 AI 日志导出进 `logs/`，独立 10 分维度）

## 分工（2026-09-14 决定）

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's recipe covers them) at the effort level given first, before any target (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings to many, some uncertain); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply them to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. - Use the max level only when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask for it, never on your own judgment: it is the costliest level and starts many reviewer subagents.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

结论：stack_manager.c 运行时不做 bluelet/zephyr 选择——它只调统一 SAL 接口（bt_sal_*），真正选择在编译期由 Kconfig 选择项（默认 bluelet）决定编译 `service/stacks/bluelet/` 或 `service/stacks/zephyr/` 哪套源码；init 失败即早退返回错误码，而两支持宏都未定义时 `stack_manager_init` 返回未初始化的 `ret`（未定义行为）。

证据：
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/stack_manager.c:29-31` `vhal = get_bt_vhal_interface(); bt_sal_get_stack_info(&info);` —— 只调 SAL 抽象接口，文件内无任何 bluelet/zephyr 分支判断。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/stack_manager.c:34-38` `#ifdef CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BREDR_SUPPORT ret = bt_sal_init(vhal); if (ret != BT_STATUS_SUCCESS) return ret;` —— BREDR 初始化失败立即返回错误码（缺失/失败行为①）。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/stack_manager.c:40-44` `#ifdef CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BLE_SUPPORT ret = bt_sal_le_init(vhal); if (ret != BT_STATUS_SUCCESS) return ret;` —— BLE 同样早退。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/stack_manager.c:25,46` `bt_status_t ret; ... return ret;` —— 若 `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BREDR_SUPPORT` 与 `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BLE_SUPPORT` 均未定义，两个 `#ifdef` 块都跳过，`ret` 从未赋值即返回（缺失行为②，未定义行为/缺陷）。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/Kconfig:201-211` `choice prompt "Select BR stack" default BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_BLUELET; config BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_BLUELET ... select LIB_BLUELET; config BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_ZBLUE ... config BLUETOOTH_STACK_NOT_SUPPORT_CLASSIC_BT` —— BR 栈编译期选择，默认 bluelet。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/Kconfig:218-228` `choice prompt "Select LE stack" default BLUETOOTH_STACK_LE_BLUELET ... config BLUETOOTH_STACK_LE_ZBLUE ... config BLUETOOTH_STACK_NOT_SUPPORT_LE` —— LE 栈同样编译期选择，默认 bluelet。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/Makefile:229-236` `ifneq ($(CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_BLUELET)$(CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_LE_BLUELET),) CSRCS += service/stacks/bluelet/*.c ... ifneq ($(CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_ZBLUE)$(CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_LE_ZBLUE),) CSRCS += service/stacks/zephyr/hci_h4.c ... sal_zblue.c sal_adapter_interface.c` —— Kconfig 值决定编译哪套 SAL 实现（链接期符号解析，即"选择"的落地点）。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/CMakeLists.txt:279-290` `if(CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_BLUELET OR CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_LE_BLUELET) ... if(CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_ZBLUE OR CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_LE_ZBLUE) ... sal_zblue.c sal_adapter_interface.c` —— CMake 侧同样的二选一逻辑。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/include/sal_a2dp_source_interface.h:26-27` `#elif defined(CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_STACK_BREDR_BLUELET) #include "sal_bluelet.h"` —— 头文件层也按宏选 bluelet 头（zephyr 为另一分支），stack_manager.c 经 sal_interface.h 间接依赖此机制。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/zephyr/sal_zblue.c:25-31` `bt_sal_get_stack_info(...){ snprintf(info->name, 32, "Zblue"); ... }` —— 栈身份仅由被链接的实现上报（打印于 stack_manager.c:32-33），无运行时探测。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/zephyr/sal_adapter_interface.c:702-715` `bt_sal_init(...) { ... #else return BT_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED; }` —— zephyr 实现对缺失支持（无 CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BREDR_SUPPORT）返回 NOT_SUPPORTED；但 stack_manager.c:34 的同名 `#ifdef` 使该分支经此调用路径不可达（推断：防御性冗余）。
- `frameworks/connectivity/bluetooth/service/stacks/.gitignore:1` `bluelet` —— bluelet SAL 源码目录不入库（构建时生成/拷贝）；本树 `service/stacks/bluelet/` 不存在（Glob 未找到），若构建脚本未注入则 `Makefile:230` 的 `*.c` 通配为空、链接时 `bt_sal_*` 符号缺失报错（推断）。

风险/不确定：bluelet 侧 `bt_sal_init`/`bt_sal_get_stack_info` 的具体实现源码不在本树（`service/stacks/bluelet/` 缺失，gitignore 注入机制未逐查），其缺失时行为属推断。
